title: 2021 HMMT November Team Problem 1
statement: Let \(A B C D\) be a parallelogram. Let \(E\) be the midpoint of \(A B\) and \(F\) be the midpoint of \(C D\). Points \(P\) and \(Q\) are on segments \(E F\) and \(C F\), respectively, such that \(A, P\), and \(Q\) are collinear. Given that \(E P=5, P F=3\), and \(Q F=12\), find \(C Q\).

solutions.text:
Triangles \(P F Q\) and \(P E A\) are similar, so \(A E=F Q \cdot \frac{P E}{P F}=12 \cdot \frac{5}{3}=20\). Now, \(C Q=C F-Q F=\) \(20-12=8\).
